name: Shin'en Byoutou
source:
One day, Tamiya Shouichi wakes up in a mental hospital.
Why is he there? Has he gone mad?
Insanity and intrigue blend together in this story, set in the early days of Shouwa.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ01056803.html]DLSite[/url]]
translation:
某天，Tamiya Shouichi在精神病院醒来。
为什么会在这里？自己疯了吗？
以昭和初年为舞台，疯狂与阴谋交织的故事就此展开。

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ01056803.html]DLSite[/url]]
